READY-PREPARED FOOD.Definition: food that is already made and only needs heating or opening

FROM SCRATCH.Definition: using raw, basic ingredients rather than ready-made food

GOURMET.Definition: high-quality and special, for people who love fine food

NUTRITION.Definition: the substances the body needs to grow and stay healthy

ECO-FRIENDLINESS.Definition: the quality of not harming the natural world

PICKY.Definition: hard to please; careful to choose only what they like

CHAINS.Definition: groups of shops with the same name, owned by one company

BREAKING INTO.Definition: starting to do business successfully in

WOO.Definition: try to attract and win over

FISH.Definition: reach and search with your hand

MOPPING UP.Definition: cleaning from the floor with a wet cloth on a stick

SPILLED.Definition: accidentally poured out of its container

CHECKOUT TILL.Definition: the counter where customers pay for their shopping

BARCODES.Definition: patterns of black lines on products that a machine reads to find the price

BENCHMARK ITEMS.Definition: common products whose prices people use to compare shops

PLANTS.Definition: deliberately places, to get people talking

OWN BRAND.Definition: made specially for the shop and sold under its name

LOGO.Definition: a symbol or design that a company uses to identify itself

NOTORIOUSLY.Definition: in a way that is well known, often for a bad reason

BUDGET-CONSCIOUS.Definition: careful about how much money they spend

BARGAIN.Definition: cheap; something sold for less than its usual price

CAVIAR.Definition: the salted eggs of a large fish, eaten as an expensive luxury food

WORD STARTED TO SPREAD.Definition: more and more people began to hear about it

LEST I FORGET.Definition: in case I forget; so that I don't forget

CANNY.Definition: clever and careful, especially with money

BARGAIN HUNTERS.Definition: people who search for low prices and good deals

AISLE.Definition: a passage between rows of shelves in a shop

CRUISE DOWN.Definition: move slowly and in a relaxed way along

DOG SHADE TENT.Definition: a small tent that keeps a dog out of the sun

OF SORTS.Definition: of a kind, though not a perfect example

CATCH UP.Definition: get close to the level of older, bigger rivals

DIE-HARD.Definition: very loyal and unlikely to change
